Each semantically approved input still requires current explicit authorization, an active route lease/input lock, and a fresh source/generation fence; shortage may defer without changing the confirmed prefix, and unresolved evidence returns unknown without identical retry.
bounded_recovery_behavior: A normal single Upgrade opens a separate bulk row that may occlude the material balance. Positively identify that row, use at most one non-spending Back per pending single action, and recognize either current Wali details or the Hero roster followed by current named Wali reselection. Never press the bulk row or repeat an unknown dismissal. Commit only a settled level-plus-one with the exact ANTISERUM debit. Persist confirmed normal actions across evolution and restart. Missing or contradictory settlement, receipt, cost, balance, or reset identity is unknown; deny identical retry. The Campaign/reset/150-diamond path remains evidence_required and blocked.
